facts.fact: TechnoMag reports POTRAZ's Director General set out a 2025/26 enforcement roadmap under the Cyber and Data Protection Act: education, support and corrective warnings with deadlines in 2025, and fines and possible criminal charges from 2026, with no sanction yet reported.

TechnoMag reports POTRAZ, led by its Director General, is acting as the enforcing regulator under the CDPA, handing over data controller licences and planning inspections triggered by complaints and unlicensed processing.
